name: loadpath
description: Build a strength training workout or program and get a link that opens it in Loadpath, the iPhone strength training app.

interface.longDescription:
Ask for a workout or a program (5/3/1, GZCLP, push/pull/legs, upper/lower, full body, a beginner plan) and get a link that opens it in Loadpath, the iPhone strength training app.

The plan is written in Loadpath's own format: lifts by the names in Loadpath's library, sets and reps, and progression Loadpath runs for you: adding weight when every rep lands, rep ranges, 5/3/1 training maxes and GZCLP tiers. Weights come from your own history in the app, so the plan works for any lifter.

The link opens the plan as a preview in Loadpath 2.7 or later, and nothing is saved until you tap Save. Without the app, it opens a page that shows the plan and how to get Loadpath. Where code can't run, you get the plan as text to paste into Train → + → Import from Text.
capabilities: Link a plan to open in Loadpath
defaultPrompt: Build me a 3-day full-body beginner plan for Loadpath
